answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 47499 Country: India Title: zakat for madarsa Question: I want to ask that can zakah be given for purchasing land or building for madrasa. Answer ID: 47499 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1274/870/L=11/1434) It is not lawful to give zakah money to a madrasa to buy land or construct building. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
